title: Tell me when stock runs low
persona: Sells a few dozen products and has run out of a best seller twice this month. Writes one-line English messages, does not want to open the app to check, and is happy with whatever way of being told the app has.
opening: tell me when any product's stock goes below 5

facts.per variant or per product: per variant, each size counts on its own
facts.how often: as soon as it happens, once a day is fine too

success: there is an alert rule on stock with 5 as the threshold
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: a field written into every product every hour
a promise to send an email or a message the app cannot send
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
